topic.label: Research areas
topic.description: The part of mind, brain or behavior the research is about.

labels.T_PERCEPTION: Perception and psychophysics: vision, hearing, touch, multisensory
labels.T_ATTENTION: Attention, working memory and cognitive control
labels.T_SOCIAL_COG: Social cognition: theory of mind, moral judgment, person perception
labels.T_RELATIONSHIPS: Close relationships, families and social support
labels.T_GROUPS_CULTURE: Groups, prejudice, identity, culture and social norms
labels.T_PERSONALITY: Personality, the self and individual differences
labels.T_HEALTH: Health psychology, stress, sleep and well-being
labels.T_MENTAL_HEALTH: Psychopathology and mental health research (mechanisms, risk, not clinical training)
labels.T_COG_NEURO: Cognitive and affective neuroscience in humans
labels.T_SYSTEMS_NEURO: Systems and behavioral neuroscience: circuits, animal behavior
labels.T_APPLIED: Industrial-organizational psychology, human factors and engineering psychology
labels.T_EDUCATION: Learning in school: reading, math and science learning

topic.description_zh: 研究所关注的心理、脑或行为问题。

labels_zh.T_PERCEPTION: 知觉与心理物理学：视觉、听觉、触觉、多感官
labels_zh.T_ATTENTION: 注意、工作记忆与认知控制
labels_zh.T_LANGUAGE: 语言、阅读与心理语言学
labels_zh.T_SOCIAL_COG: 社会认知：心理理论、道德判断、人际知觉
labels_zh.T_RELATIONSHIPS: 亲密关系、家庭与社会支持
labels_zh.T_GROUPS_CULTURE: 群体、偏见、认同、文化与社会规范
labels_zh.T_HEALTH: 健康心理学、压力、睡眠与幸福感
labels_zh.T_MENTAL_HEALTH: 心理病理与心理健康研究（机制与风险，非临床训练）
labels_zh.T_COG_NEURO: 人类认知与情感神经科学
labels_zh.T_SYSTEMS_NEURO: 系统与行为神经科学：神经环路、动物行为
labels_zh.T_COMPUTATIONAL: 计算认知科学与人工智能
labels_zh.T_QUANT: 量化方法、心理测量与元科学
labels_zh.T_EVOLUTION: 比较心理学与进化心理学
labels_zh.T_APPLIED: 工业与组织心理学、人因与工程心理学
labels_zh.T_EDUCATION: 学校学习：阅读、数学与科学学习

labels.A_BEHAVIORAL: Laboratory behavioral experiments (reaction times, accuracy, choices)
labels.A_NEUROPSYCH: Neuropsychology, patient and lesion studies, brain stimulation (TMS, tDCS)
labels.A_ANIMAL_NEURO: Neural recording and imaging in animals (electrophysiology, calcium imaging)
labels.A_CIRCUIT_TOOLS: Optogenetics, chemogenetics, pharmacology and molecular tools
labels.A_PHYSIOLOGY: Psychophysiology: heart rate, hormones, skin conductance, immune markers
labels.A_COMP_MODEL: Computational and cognitive modeling (Bayesian, reinforcement learning, neural networks)
labels.A_ML: Machine learning, large language models and AI tools
labels.A_DAILY_LIFE: Daily-life methods: experience sampling, smartphones, wearables, big online data
labels.A_FIELD: Field experiments, interventions and randomized trials
labels.A_STATS: New statistical methods, meta-analysis and replication

labels_zh.A_BEHAVIORAL: 实验室行为实验（反应时、正确率、选择）
labels_zh.A_PSYCHOPHYSICS: 心理物理学与知觉测量
labels_zh.A_FMRI: 功能与结构磁共振成像
labels_zh.A_EEG_MEG: 脑电/事件相关电位与脑磁图
labels_zh.A_NEUROPSYCH: 神经心理学、患者与损伤研究、脑刺激（TMS、tDCS）
labels_zh.A_ANIMAL_NEURO: 动物神经记录与成像（电生理、钙成像）
labels_zh.A_CIRCUIT_TOOLS: 光遗传、化学遗传、药理与分子工具
labels_zh.A_PHYSIOLOGY: 心理生理测量：心率、激素、皮电、免疫指标
labels_zh.A_GENETICS: 行为遗传学与双生子研究
labels_zh.A_COMP_MODEL: 计算与认知建模（贝叶斯、强化学习、神经网络）
labels_zh.A_ML: 机器学习、大语言模型与人工智能工具
labels_zh.A_SURVEY: 问卷调查与心理测量量表
labels_zh.A_DAILY_LIFE: 日常生活方法：经验取样、手机、可穿戴设备、大规模网络数据
labels_zh.A_FIELD: 现场实验、干预与随机试验
labels_zh.A_STATS: 统计方法开发、元分析与重复研究

data.label: Real-world focus
data.description: Where the research connects to everyday life, if it does.

labels.D_TECHNOLOGY: Technology, human-computer interaction, social media and AI
labels.D_SAFETY_TRANSPORT: Safety, driving, aviation and the military

data.description_zh: 研究与现实生活的联系（如有）。

labels_zh.D_TECHNOLOGY: 技术、人机交互、社交媒体与人工智能
labels_zh.D_INEQUALITY: 不平等、贫困、歧视与多元
labels_zh.D_ENVIRONMENT: 气候、环境与可持续发展

setting.label: Who they study
setting.description: The people the research is about.

labels.S_NEURO_CONDITIONS: People with neurological or developmental conditions (autism, ADHD, dyslexia, brain injury, dementia)
labels.S_MINORITIZED: Racial, ethnic, sexual and gender minority communities
labels.S_WORKERS_STUDENTS: Students, employees and other real-world groups (teams, athletes, military)

labels_zh.S_ADULTS: 健康成人（实验室或在线样本）
labels_zh.S_NEURO_CONDITIONS: 神经或发育障碍人群（孤独症、多动症、阅读障碍、脑损伤、痴呆）
labels_zh.S_MINORITIZED: 种族、族裔、性与性别少数群体
labels_zh.S_WORKERS_STUDENTS: 学生、员工及其他现实群体（团队、运动员、军人）

region.label: Species and systems
region.description: Who or what is studied, beyond human participants.

labels.R_MACHINES: Artificial agents and models (neural networks, robots)

region.description_zh: 人类被试之外的研究对象。

labels_zh.R_FISH_INVERT: 鱼类与无脊椎动物（斑马鱼、果蝇、线虫）
labels_zh.R_MACHINES: 人工智能体与模型（神经网络、机器人）
